name: Disneyland Hotel Villas Palm Breeze Bar: Grilled Chicken Sandwich, Artisanal Burger & Warm Beignets
brandOrRestaurant: Palm Breeze Bar (The Villas at Disneyland Hotel · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Open-air pool restaurant at the new Disneyland Hotel DVC tower serving scratch-made grilled chicken sandwiches, burgers, salmon, and kids' chicken tenders/pasta with easy walk-up seating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken or Burger plain on a brioche bun with aged cheddar/Swiss and fries.
watchOuts: Ask for spicy aiolis and citrus dressings on the side
